title: T3: the consoles' tables on the table standard
why: Jason, 2026-11-19: "go on all three" (T3-T5 of design/table-standard.md). One enhancer in admin-kit.js, TvAdmin.staticTable(), puts the tables the admin's pages write themselves on the standard, starting with the consoles' (.ak-aa and .cs-t: Automation, Service register, Costs, Workflow board, Communications, Crawler, the index): sentence-case headers, tap a header to sort (again to reverse, a third time for the page's own order), numbers right-aligned, a column with nothing in it named under the table, phone cards, and past 25 rows the count, Show 10/25/50/100 (remembered) and the page bar. Rows are only shown or hidden, never rebuilt, so their buttons and fields keep working; a field or button counts as filled. T4 (the admin pages) and T5 (the shared parts) mark their tables with data-tv-table. FAQ: the admin's lists entry.
